Remark
[basic covering lemma]

Source: petersen:page-0323 ↗ thm:pet-ch7-maximal-function-theorem 1. ch7:7.5.5Given a separable metric space $(X,d)$ and a bounded positive function $R:X\to (0,D]$, show there is a countable $A\subset X$ such that the balls $B(p,R(p))$, $p\in A$, are pairwise disjoint and $X=\bigcup _{p\in A}B(p,5R(p))$. (Hint: choose the points successively so that $R(p_{k+1})\ge \tfrac 12\sup _{p\in X\setminus \bigcup _iB(p_i,2R(p_i))}R(p)$.)
